fusions.name: Set and Drive
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. You drive a blow home that deals 24 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at your full 4-tile reach.

fusions.name: Steady Tapping
fusions.desc: A quick, measured tap that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Eye on the Mark
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Smith's Mitts
fusions.desc: Conjures a pair of smith's mitts: your critical chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 15% more, each kill returns 3 health, and your maximum health rises by 10.
